workflow:
name: Update iShares ETF data
on:
  # Weekly refresh (every Sunday at 00:00 UTC) plus manual runs.
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_fetches:
        description: "Batch size; continue after the saved ticker cursor; empty or 0 means all"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      request_sleep:
        description: "Seconds between outgoing request starts"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      aum:
        description: "AUM min:max; bounds may be amounts or nano/micro/small/mid/large"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      concurrency:
        description: "Parallel fund update workers"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      holdings_page_size:
        description: "Rows in each generated current-holdings JSON page"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      history_page_size:
        description: "Rows in each generated historical NAV JSON page"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      store_raw_downloads:
        description: "Store source XLS files (true/yes/on/1)"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      max_retries:
        description: "Retries after the initial request (default 2)"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      tickers:
        description: "Only update these tickers, separated by spaces or commas"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      dividend_yield:
        description: "12m trailing dividend yield range: min:max, min:, :max, or :"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      performance_ytd:
        description: "YTD NAV performance range: min:max, min:, :max, or :; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      performance_1y:
        description: "1Y average-annual NAV performance range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      performance_3y:
        description: "3Y average-annual NAV performance/CAGR range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      performance_5y:
        description: "5Y average-annual NAV performance/CAGR range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      performance_10y:
        description: "10Y average-annual NAV performance/CAGR range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      total_return_ytd:
        description: "YTD cumulative NAV total-return range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      total_return_1y:
        description: "1Y cumulative NAV total-return range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      total_return_3y:
        description: "3Y cumulative NAV total-return range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      total_return_5y:
        description: "5Y cumulative NAV total-return range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      total_return_10y:
        description: "10Y cumulative NAV total-return range; colon required"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
permissions: { contents: write }
concurrency: { group: update-data, cancel-in-progress: false }
jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      MAX_FETCHES: ${{ inputs.max_fetches || '' }}
      REQUEST_SLEEP: ${{ inputs.request_sleep || '' }}
      AUM: ${{ inputs.aum || '' }}
      CONCURRENCY: ${{ inputs.concurrency || '' }}
      HOLDINGS_PAGE_SIZE: ${{ inputs.holdings_page_size || '' }}
      HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE: ${{ inputs.history_page_size || '' }}
      STORE_RAW_DOWNLOADS: ${{ inputs.store_raw_downloads || '' }}
      MAX_RETRIES: ${{ inputs.max_retries || '' }}
      TICKERS: ${{ inputs.tickers || '' }}
      DIVIDEND_YIELD: ${{ inputs.dividend_yield || '' }}
      PERFORMANCE_YTD: ${{ inputs.performance_ytd || '' }}
      PERFORMANCE_1Y: ${{ inputs.performance_1y || '' }}
      PERFORMANCE_3Y: ${{ inputs.performance_3y || '' }}
      PERFORMANCE_5Y: ${{ inputs.performance_5y || '' }}
      PERFORMANCE_10Y: ${{ inputs.performance_10y || '' }}
      TOTAL_RETURN_YTD: ${{ inputs.total_return_ytd || '' }}
      TOTAL_RETURN_1Y: ${{ inputs.total_return_1y || '' }}
      TOTAL_RETURN_3Y: ${{ inputs.total_return_3y || '' }}
      TOTAL_RETURN_5Y: ${{ inputs.total_return_5y || '' }}
      TOTAL_RETURN_10Y: ${{ inputs.total_return_10y || '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Test updater
        run: bun test scripts/update-data.test.ts
      - name: Update data
        run: bun scripts/update-data.ts
      - name: Commit changed data
        run: |
          git add api/ishares
          git diff --cached --quiet && exit 0
          git config user.name github-actions[bot]
          git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          git commit -m 'Update iShares ETF data'
          git push
observations: Flat string-valued scripts/update-data.config.json; module-relative read before runtime config parsing.
Only undefined or whitespace-only environment values are filled; nonblank 0/false overrides remain intact.
Missing JSON ENOENT uses built-in fallbacks; malformed/unreadable JSON throws.
Manual inputs are optional strings with empty defaults; job-level env maps inputs to canonical controls.
Schedule+manual only; checkout@v7, setup-bun@v2 with no fixed version; install -> updater tests -> update -> api-only commit/push.

Reference has STORE_RAW_DOWNLOADS (unsupported by Xtrackers), no TER/SEC_YIELD/SEC_UA workflow inputs and VERBOSE file-only. Xtrackers must preserve its supported 23 controls and DWS 1.5s/2-lane defaults.
Reference directive is after imports; target must keep explicit first/second-line directive requirement.
Reference README defaults/unsupported controls are stale; target docs/help will reflect actual JSON, not copy false settings.
